{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
if [ -e /root/matrix.txt ] && [ -r /root/matrix.txt ]; then
  perms=$(stat -c "%A %a %U:%G" /root/matrix.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "?" )
  echo "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") /root/matrix.txt exists and is readable. $perms" > temp_workspace/metadata.txt
else
  echo "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") /root/matrix.txt missing or not readable." > temp_workspace/metadata.txt
fi

cp -- /root/matrix.txt temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt
echo "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") Copied /root/matrix.txt to temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt" >> temp_workspace/operations.log

in=temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt
tmp=temp_workspace/_tmp_norm.txt
sed 's/\r$//' "$in" > "$tmp"
total=$(wc -l < "$tmp" | tr -d ' ')
last_non_empty=$(awk '{ if($0 ~ /[^[:space:]]/) last=NR } END{ if (last=="") print 0; else print last }' "$tmp")
if [ "$last_non_empty" -eq 0 ]; then
  : > temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt
  removed=$total
else
  removed=$(( total - last_non_empty ))
  head -n "$last_non_empty" "$tmp" > temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt
fi
rm -f "$tmp"
size=$(stat -c%s temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
echo "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") Normalized line endings; removed $removed trailing empty lines; output temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt size ${size} bytes" >> temp_workspace/operations.log

echo "normalized_path: temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt" > temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt
echo "byte_size: ${size}" >> temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt
echo "metadata: temp_workspace/metadata.txt" >> temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt
echo "operations_log: temp_workspace/operations.log" >> temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt

wc -l < /root/matrix.txt
"}
